data.description: For each alcoholic drink an Ataxian has consumed in the past hour, it gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC and takes a -1 penalty on all attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks, to a maximum of +4 and -4 respectively. These effects wear off after 1 hour.
data.name: Staggering Drunk
